title: Single Comment Generator with device-based locking, dynamic available count, and admin metrics charts

requirements.text: Add the following stable storage structures to the Motoko backend actor: (1) a stable HashMap keyed by a composite key '(listId#deviceId)' (Text) mapping to a claimed timestamp (Int), persisted via preupgrade/postupgrade hooks into a stable array; (2) a stable HashMap keyed by listId (Text) mapping to an array of used template indices (stable [Nat]), also persisted via preupgrade/postupgrade hooks. These must survive canister upgrades without data loss.
acceptanceCriteria: Canister upgrade does not reset claims or used-index data
preupgrade serializes both HashMaps to stable arrays
postupgrade rebuilds both HashMaps from those stable arrays
No hardcoded values exist in the stable structures

requirements.text: Add an atomic update function `generateComment(listId: Text, deviceId: Text) : async Result<Text, Text>` to the Motoko backend. The function must: (1) check if the composite key '(listId#deviceId)' exists in the claims HashMap — if yes, return Err('Already generated on this device for this list'); (2) find the first template index for the given listId that is NOT in the used-indices set; (3) if no unused index exists, return Err('No comments left for this list'); (4) mark that index as used by inserting it into the per-list used-indices map; (5) insert the claim key into the claims HashMap; (6) return Ok(templateText) where templateText is the template at the selected index (with the list's optional suffix appended if present). The entire operation must be a single update call with no intermediate awaits that could allow a race condition.
acceptanceCriteria: First call from a deviceId for a listId returns a template string wrapped in Ok
Second call from the same deviceId for the same listId returns Err('Already generated on this device for this list')
A call to a list with all indices used returns Err('No comments left for this list')
Returned text includes the list suffix if one is set
No hardcoded comment text is returned

requirements.text: Add a query function `getListMetrics() : async [ListMetrics]` to the Motoko backend, where ListMetrics is a record type containing: listId (Text), listName (Text), totalTemplates (Nat), usedTemplates (Nat), availableTemplates (Nat), percentUsed (Float). For each comment list, availableTemplates = totalTemplates - usedTemplates, and percentUsed = usedTemplates / totalTemplates * 100 (return 0.0 if totalTemplates is 0). All values must be calculated dynamically from actual stored data — no hardcoded numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns one entry per comment list
totalTemplates matches the actual template array size for that list
usedTemplates matches the size of the used-indices set for that list
availableTemplates equals totalTemplates minus usedTemplates
percentUsed returns 0.0 when totalTemplates is 0
No hardcoded values in the response

requirements.text: Add a query function `getAvailableCount(listId: Text) : async Nat` to the Motoko backend that returns the number of unused template indices for the given list (totalTemplates - usedIndices.size()). This is used by the frontend to display the dynamic 'Available Comments: N' counter without requiring a full metrics fetch.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns correct count for a list with no used templates (equals total templates)
Returns correct count after one comment has been generated (decrements by 1)
Returns 0 when all templates are used
Returns 0 for an unknown listId

requirements.text: In the frontend UserView, redesign the Single Comment Generator section to match the uploaded screenshot exactly: (1) a card with a blue gradient icon (sparkle/star), title 'Single Comment Generator', subtitle 'Generate one comment per list (one per device)'; (2) a 'Select Comment List' dropdown showing only unlocked lists for the selected app/event (keep the existing App/Event selector above it); (3) an 'Available Comments' display box showing the dynamic count fetched from the backend's `getAvailableCount` query for the selected list — the number must reflect real stored data, not a hardcoded value; (4) a lock notice box (blue tinted, with sparkle icon) showing 'You have already generated a comment for this list on this device.' when the device has already claimed a comment from the selected list; (5) a 'Generate Single Comment' button with a blue-to-teal gradient matching the screenshot, disabled (and showing the lock notice) if the device has already claimed a comment from this list. On successful generation, display the generated comment text with a Copy button below the card. On 'No comments left' error, show an 'Out of comments' badge instead.
acceptanceCriteria: Available Comments counter shows a real number from the backend, not 28 or any other hardcoded value
Available Comments counter updates when a different list is selected
Lock notice appears if localStorage contains a claim for the selected list's deviceId+listId combination
Generate button is disabled when the lock notice is visible
Successful generation displays the comment text and a Copy to Clipboard button
Out-of-comments error shows a distinct badge/message instead of the Generate button
Card layout, icon, gradient button, and color scheme match the uploaded screenshot

requirements.text: In the frontend, on app load, ensure a persistent deviceId exists: read from localStorage key 'deviceId'; if missing, generate one via `crypto.randomUUID()` and store it back in localStorage. Pass this deviceId to the `generateComment` backend call. After a successful generation, store the claim in localStorage as a record keyed by listId so the UI can immediately show the lock notice without an extra backend round-trip on re-render.
acceptanceCriteria: localStorage 'deviceId' is created on first load and reused on subsequent loads
deviceId is sent with every generateComment call
After a successful generation, the lock notice appears immediately without a page reload
Claim state in localStorage persists across browser tab refreshes

requirements.text: Add an Admin Metrics section inside the Admin > Comments sub-tab (or as a separate 'Metrics' sub-section within the Admin panel). For each comment list, display a card showing: list name, Total / Used / Available counts (all dynamic from the backend `getListMetrics` query), a horizontal progress bar (Used/Total fill percentage), and a pure SVG/CSS donut chart visualizing Used (filled arc) vs Available (unfilled arc) using stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset on an SVG circle element. No Recharts or other chart library may be added. All numbers must come from real backend data with zero hardcoded values.
acceptanceCriteria: Each list has its own metrics card
Total, Used, and Available counts match backend values
Progress bar fill percentage equals usedTemplates / totalTemplates * 100
SVG donut arc correctly represents used vs available proportion
Shows 0% fill when no templates have been used
Shows 100% fill when all templates are used
No Recharts or external chart dependency is added
No hardcoded numbers anywhere in the metrics UI

constraints: Do not add Recharts or any external chart library — use pure SVG/CSS donut only
Do not hardcode any comment counts anywhere in backend or frontend
Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Do not touch Admin panel files for the UI redesign
Stable storage must persist across canister upgrades via preupgrade/postupgrade hooks
generateComment must be a single atomic update call with no intermediate awaits
nonGoals: Adding SQL transactions, PostgreSQL, or any external database
WebSocket-based real-time chart updates (polling or manual refetch is sufficient)
Changing the existing CRUD operations for comment lists or app events
Changing the admin PIN code or authentication flow
Modifying the Top-Down Shooter game component
Modifying the Bulk Comments Generator in the Upload tab
